about.headline: About STDM
about.subheadline: We integrate IT, digital marketing and technical support so businesses can create, operate and grow with one accountable partner.
about.historyBody: STDM is the commercial brand of SIS Technologies Digital Marketing S.R.L. What began as technology and digital service capabilities evolved into a broader partner model: helping companies solve problems across software, cloud, marketing and technical support without juggling multiple disconnected vendors.
about.visionBody: To position STDM as the partner of choice for organizations that need IT, digital marketing and technical support to work together — enabling long-term partnerships and cross-functional value instead of one-off projects.
about.capabilitiesSubtitle: Three business units that work together under one delivery model.

capabilities.technology: Software development, cloud solutions, IT consulting, DevOps, infrastructure, cybersecurity and industrial technology — with installation and support.
capabilities.digital: Digital marketing, paid media, SEO, social media, marketing automation and analytics focused on measurable business outcomes.
capabilities.equipment: Help desk, preventive and corrective maintenance, and remote or on-site support in Costa Rica. Computer equipment supply is a complement, quoted on request.

about.experienceBody: Our team combines software engineering, solution architecture, digital strategy, creative production and operational support. That mix lets us move from strategy to implementation — and stay accountable after go-live.
about.coverageBody: We operate from Costa Rica and serve companies that need a local partner with bilingual communication, practical delivery and an understanding of regional business conditions. Our focus is B2B across retail, manufacturing, construction, education, healthcare, hospitality, professional services and financial institutions.
about.methodologySubtitle: A clear methodology designed for integrated delivery — not unnecessary complexity.

methodology.step1Body: We clarify goals, constraints, stakeholders and success metrics before recommending a path.
methodology.step2Body: We define the right mix across IT, digital marketing and technical support so every piece supports the business outcome.
methodology.step3Body: We implement with clear milestones, transparent communication and quality standards your team can trust.
methodology.step4Body: We stay available for training, maintenance, iteration and expansion as your needs grow.
